harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured persistent inherited ACL access on node1. Designer-owned new directories and files grant reviewer read/write access, deny visitor access, and retain inheritance across reboot. Existing project content and the legacy OS/kernel were preserved.
actions_performed: Created local accounts designer, reviewer, and visitor.
Applied access and default ACLs to /srv/legacy2/inherited-directory-acls/projects.
Verified inheritance using designer-created directories and documents under umask 077.
Verified reviewer could read and update inherited files while visitor was denied.
Confirmed no project-specific periodic permission-fixing job exists.
Restarted node1 safely and verified changed boot identity, SSH recovery, persistent accounts, ACLs, ownership, access behavior, and data.

evidence.requirement: Persistent inherited access with designer ownership, reviewer read/write, and visitor denial
evidence.summary: Default ACLs are present; post-restart creation produced designer-owned directory/file with effective reviewer read/write access, and visitor remained denied.
Direct id output confirms designer UID 501, reviewer UID 502, and visitor UID 503 before and after restart.
brief.txt remained 50 bytes with unchanged SHA-256 5c077cd26fc7d84d4c43e9b5dfa674428ab1ce50c38422e63678d35043f43082.
No scheduled job referencing inherited-directory-acls was found; inheritance is supplied directly by default ACLs.

evidence.requirement: Legacy operating-system release and kernel preserved
evidence.summary: Node remained on CentOS 5.11 with kernel 2.6.18-398.el5.

Healthy baseline used boot ID 9165da0c-3dd5-4d72-8000-000000000000; native reboot was acknowledged, node became unavailable during restart, and recovered with changed boot ID 265d5ad2-975a-4842-8000-000000000000. SSH, accounts, ACLs, ownership, data, and functional access all recovered.
